text: Slime-forming Lc. lactis subsp. cremoris produce an exopolysaccharide network that binds casein into viili's stretchy, adhesive gel, while diacetylactis strains and Leuconostoc add aroma. Unhomogenised cream rises and the mould Geotrichum candidum grows a velvety skin on it.
